Name: Higher Order Statues of Fortune
Author: svalawoo
Description:
Requires Content Patcher.

In this version, all three statues can be purchased for 1 million G from Krobus.



All statues give output at the beginning of every day.
[b]
Statue of Second-Order Fortune: [/b]produces vanilla Statues of Endless Fortune
[b]Statue of Third-Order Fortune: ﻿[/b]produces Statues of Second-Order Fortune
[b]Statue of Fourth-Order Fortune: [/b]produces Statues of Third-order Fortune


 
(Trivia)
The returns from these statues are not exponential in growth, but polynomial.
If every statue is collected from and placed every day, the total numbers of statues would match diagonals on Pascal's Triangle.

Manifest.Name: Higher Order Fortune Statues
Manifest.Description: A second-order statue that gives statues of Endless Fortune, a third-order statue that gives second-order statues, and a fourth-order statue giving third-order statues.
